Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.label: cold-weather pack
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.description: A block heater in every engine and a deep-cycle battery, with the night heater switched on: a vehicle ready for winter camps and frozen mornings.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.label: all-terrain tyres
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.description: All-terrain tyres on every wheel at once, for a vehicle bound for mud, sand or snow.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.label: work lights
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.description: Work lamps on the vehicle, switched on, so a camp or a site round it can work through the night.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.label: long range
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.description: Extra fuel for a long trip: an auxiliary tank on a land vehicle or a boat, a ferry tank in an aircraft's cabin. Either costs cargo space.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.label: recovery
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosVehicleFamil.description: A recovery winch, straps and a tow bar: drag a bogged or broken vehicle out, then tow it home behind this one.
